title: Toys — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Toys Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Commercial product name or trade designation of the toy

modelNumber.title: Model / SKU
modelNumber.description: Model number, SKU, or product variant identifier

batchLotNumber.title: Batch / Serial Number
batchLotNumber.description: Batch or serial number for product traceability and recall purposes

gtin.title: GTIN / Barcode
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number (EAN/UPC barcode) for the product

productImageUrl.title: Product Image
productImageUrl.description: URL to the main product image

ceMarking.title: CE Marking
ceMarking.description: Whether the toy bears the CE marking, confirming conformity with EU toy safety requirements

declarationOfConformityUrl.title: EU Declaration of Conformity
declarationOfConformityUrl.description: URL to the EU Declaration of Conformity document per Toy Safety Directive

intendedAgeGroup.title: Intended Age Group
intendedAgeGroup.description: Age range the toy is designed and intended for, as required by the Toy Safety Directive
intendedAgeGroup.x-provision: Art. 11(2) and Annex V Part B

safetyWarnings.title: Safety Warnings
safetyWarnings.description: Mandatory safety warnings per Toy Safety Directive Annex V (e.g. choking hazard, not for under 36 months)

en71TestResults.title: EN 71 Test Results
en71TestResults.description: Results of EN 71 safety testing: EN 71-1 (mechanical/physical), EN 71-2 (flammability), EN 71-3 (migration of elements)
en71TestResults.x-standard: EN 71 (safety of toys: -1 mechanical, -2 flammability, -3 migration of elements)

notifiedBody.title: Notified Body
notifiedBody.description: Name and number of the notified body involved in conformity assessment, if applicable (EC type-examination)

primaryMaterials.title: Primary Materials
primaryMaterials.description: List of primary materials used in the toy (e.g. ABS plastic, wood, cotton fabric, metal)

svhcPresent.title: SVHC Presence
svhcPresent.description: Whether the toy contains Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above 0.1% w/w per REACH Article 33

substancesOfConcern.title: Substances of Concern
substancesOfConcern.description: Detailed list of substances of concern present in the toy, including CAS numbers, concentrations, and locations (SCIP-level detail)

phthalateCompliant.title: Phthalate Compliance
phthalateCompliant.description: Confirms that restricted phthalates (DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIDP, DNOP) are each below 0.1% in plasticised material per REACH Annex XVII Entry 51

heavyMetalMigration.title: Heavy Metal Migration (EN 71-3)
heavyMetalMigration.description: EN 71-3 test results for migration of 19 elements (antimony, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, selenium, etc.) across 3 material categories

recycledContentPercentage.title: Recycled Content (%)
recycledContentPercentage.description: Percentage of recycled material by weight in the toy product

recyclabilityAssessment.title: Recyclability Assessment
recyclabilityAssessment.description: Assessment of how easily the toy can be recycled at end of life

packagingMaterial.title: Packaging Material
packagingMaterial.description: Primary material used in product packaging

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon Footprint
carbonFootprint.description: Total carbon footprint of the toy product in kg CO2 equivalent (cradle-to-gate or cradle-to-grave)

careInstructions.title: Care / Cleaning Instructions
careInstructions.description: Instructions for cleaning, maintenance, and safe use of the toy

expectedLifespan.title: Expected Lifespan
expectedLifespan.description: Expected useful lifespan of the toy under normal use conditions

disposalInstructions.title: Disposal / Recycling Instructions
disposalInstructions.description: Instructions for proper disposal or recycling of the toy at end of life, including any hazardous components (batteries, electronics)

countryOfManufacture.title: Country of Manufacture
countryOfManufacture.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the toy was manufactured

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status
ceMarkingStatus.description: Whether the product bears CE marking and its validity
